name: Ratio fund ops alerts
kind_note: Kind-aware cites, not a chrome fork. Breaks, unpriced, and NAV gate are fund-ops chrome. They stay unset on Personal / Project / Operating. UNSPECIFIED is the proto default, not a fifth kind. screensFor is not forked.

subscribe.note: webhooks:journal is a reserved catalog grant. The kernel webhook surface is not built. This app polls breaks:read + nav:read + views:read. subscribe() refuses a kernel notifier; it does not invent one.

breaks.note: breaks:read copies Break already on the book. Unexplained HIGH breaks are the alert lines. A missing BreakReport is unset — not a silent reconciled-empty list. A cited report with no lines is cited-empty (the period reconciled). This app does not invent a BreakExplanation and does not request breaks:explain.

nav_gate.note: nav:read / views:read copy GetFund / GetView nav_gate — the same blocking_at fold the console badge reads (#188). Three first-class reasons: unexplained break, unresolved trade, unpriced. Unpriced stays empty unless a valuation date was named. A missing nav_gate is unset, not an all-clear gate. A cited gate with no reasons is cited-empty (nothing blocks), and the pack says so.

unpriced.note: Unpriced is the third nav_gate list. Empty without as-of — the same limit a bare ratio strike already has. This app does not invent a mark and does not rewrite a strike.

destinations.note: Slack, email, and PagerDuty product destinations stay leftover. dry_run / deliver write a local cite pack after a ConnectApiUrl pull. They do not pretend a third-party delivery succeeded without a configured destination.

kernel_notifier.note: No chatbot, no notification service, no HTML alert UI inside ratio watch or the console binary. Ops notification is Connect breadth.

grant_path.note: first-party Connect apps call ConnectApiUrl with a verified Connect access token (authorization_code or client_credentials against WorkOS Connect). Membership still required. A Connect token never takes RATIO_DEMO_OPEN and never matches org:{id}. leftover #22: WorkOS dashboard registration, DEMO_MEMBERS naming a live WorkOS sub, unused Cognito CloudFormation resources. Write-route actor binding landed (#151). This file does not reopen #151. This file leaves #150 and #162 open. It does not reopen #151.
